item.title: Goishi Coast: Iwate's Pine-Shaded Rocky Shore — Guide
item.description: The Goishi Coast in Ofunato is a scenic stretch of the southern Sanriku shoreline — black pebble beaches (whose stones give the coast its ‘Go-stone’ name), wave-carved rock formations, and a pine-shaded coastal trail leading past thundering sea caves and blowholes. An easy, atmospheric walk on the recovering Sanriku coast. 🗓️ At a Glance Location Ofunato, Iwate Hours Trail always open (daylight best) Admission Free Time needed 1–2 hours Best time Spring–summer; clear days What to See Black pebble beaches and wave-carved rocks.
